approval_evidence.quote: NDA 212099 NDA APPROVAL Bayer HealthCare Pharmaceuticals Inc. ... for Nubeqa (darolutamide) ... for the treatment of patients with non-metastatic castration resistant prostate cancer (nmCRPC). It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (signature date 07/30/2019)

series_start_reason: Series starts 2021Q1, the first quarter Bayer prints a Nubeqa figure. Nubeqa was approved on 2019-07-30 (FDA letter above), but Bayer reports product sales only for its fifteen best-selling pharmaceuticals, and Nubeqa first entered that table during 2021: on the Q4 2021 earnings call (2022-03-01) Bayer said Nubeqa generated 'sales of EUR 219 million in 2021. In the second year after market launch, it is already one of our top 15 products.' The 2021 quarters are read from the prior-year columns of the 2022 reports. No Bayer document prints a 2019 or 2020 Nubeqa quarter.
notes: Quarterly figures sum to the printed full-year figures: 2021 219, 2022 466, 2023 869, 2024 1,523, 2025 2,385 (EUR million). Q1 and Q2 of 2024 and 2025 prior-year columns in the 2025 documents are restated (e.g. Q1 2024 285 vs 283 in its own statement); the own-quarter figure is used for each row.
